players.product: neutral-atom quantum processors (200-qubit QPU hosted at Aramco's Dhahran data center)

quarterly_data.signal: Pasqal prospectus (H1 2026 financial statements): two customers each accounted for more than 10% of consolidated revenue in the first half of 2026, generated from QPU-related services in France and Germany, together 66% of revenue (EUR 3,206 thousand); in the first half of 2025 one customer accounted for 51% (EUR 2,200 thousand), from QPU-related services in France.
quarterly_data.figure: two customers 66% of H1 2026 revenue (EUR 3,206 thousand)

quarterly_data.signal: Pasqal prospectus: H1 2026 revenue of EUR 4,872 thousand comprised QPU-related services EUR 3,944 thousand (mainly R&D services EUR 2,889 thousand and QPU upgrade services EUR 750 thousand) and cryostat sales EUR 927 thousand, with no QPU sales in either half-year; government grant income was EUR 2,950 thousand (H1 2025: EUR 3,544 thousand).
quarterly_data.figure: R&D services EUR 2,889 thousand; QPU upgrade services EUR 750 thousand; grant income EUR 2,950 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Pasqal prospectus: cash and cash equivalents of approximately EUR 312.9 million as of August 27, 2026, following the business combination with Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II and related financing transactions (EUR 110.8 million at June 30, 2026).
quarterly_data.figure: approximately EUR 312.9 million cash as of August 27, 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Pasqal prospectus (H1 2026 technology highlights): Pasqal prepared defect-free registers of 1,024 atoms, doubling its previous result of 506 atoms, and extended atom lifetimes approximately 40-fold through a redesigned cryogenic platform; it executed a full machine-learning application for solving differential equations using logical qubits, with the logical implementation outperforming its physical-qubit counterparts (which it believes is the first such comparison on a full application); with academic partners it used up to 256 atoms on its Orion Beta QPUs to simulate the magnetic material TmMgGaO4 against laboratory measurements.
quarterly_data.figure: 1,024-atom registers (from 506); atom lifetimes approximately 40-fold; up to 256 atoms

quarterly_data.signal: Partner NVIDIA: Pasqal prospectus - in March 2026 Pasqal announced the integration of NVIDIA's CUDA-Q platform with its Quantum Resource Management Interface runtime, so quantum workloads can be scheduled on Pasqal systems through standard HPC workflows for hybrid GPU-QPU computing; Pasqal expects to deploy its on-premises software stack at CINECA, integrating its quantum processor with the Leonardo supercomputer.

Partner True Nexus: Pasqal prospectus - Pasqal partnered with True Nexus to apply quantum computing to next-generation food protein design, aiming to create advanced computational models for protein functionality.
